statement: Anthropic's committed capacity is concentrated in a handful of providers, with Google and AWS together contributing 11GW of the total.
why: When one buyer's committed capacity sits mostly with two suppliers, both the buyer and those suppliers carry concentrated counterparty risk that can whipsaw order flow.

impact.mechanism: Two hyperscalers carrying the bulk of one lab's committed gigawatts concentrates the order book: their capex plans, and any renegotiation by the lab, move merchant-GPU and custom-silicon demand disproportionately.

evidence.excerpt: the largest providers will be Google and AWS, which will combined contribute 11GW of capacity

confidence.basis: Secondary, paywall-limited excerpts; provider split is reported without contract documents.

dispersion: Google and AWS shares are combined, not split individually.
